entities.name: PMID:27509402
observations: Human sinonasal epithelial cultures responded to Staphylococcus epidermidis conditioned medium with a rapid NOS-mediated NO-related signal measured by DAF-FM fluorescence; response was weaker than to S. aureus conditioned medium.

entities.name: Sinonasal epithelial NO response
observations: In vitro human sinonasal air–liquid-interface cultures showed a rapid NOS-mediated DAF-FM signal after exposure to S. epidermidis conditioned medium; this does not establish response to live-bacterium contact or quantify intact-human nasal NO.
